## 我的docker配置
### db
#### mysql

[https://blog.csdn.net/weixin_43369296/article/details/133203232](https://blog.csdn.net/weixin_43369296/article/details/133203232)

docker run -d -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=admin --name mysql -e MYSQL_ROOT_HOST=% -v D:/work/docker/mysql/mysql8/data:/var/lib/mysql -p 3306:3306 mysql:latest

docker run -d -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=admin --name mysql -v /data/mysql5/my.cnf:/etc/mysql/my.cnf -v /data/mysql/data:/var/lib/mysql -p 3307:3306 mysql

docker run -d -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=admin --name mysql -v /data/mysql8/my.cnf:/etc/mysql/my.cnf -v /data/mysql/data:/var/lib/mysql -p 3308:3306 mysql

#### tdengine
docker run -d --name tdengine -p 6030:6030 -p 6041:6041 -v D:/work/docker/tdengine/data:/var/lib/taos -v D:/work/docker//tdengine/log:/var/log/taos  tdengine/tdengine:latest

docker run -d  name tdengine-web -p 8080:80 -e TDENGINE_API=http://127.0.0.1:6041 tdengine/tdengine-web:latest

用户名和密码 root  taosdata
### redis
docker run --name redis -p 6379:6379 -v D:\work\docker\redis\redis.conf:/etc/redis/redis.conf -v D:\work\docker\redis\data:/data -d redis redis-server /etc/redis/redis.conf --appendonly yes
### sftp

docker run -d -p 0.0.0.0:2222:22 --name sftp -v D:\work\docker\sftp\sftp-data:/home/admin -e SFTP_USERS=admin:123456 sftp  admin:123456:1000

timeout /t 3 /nobreak >nul

docker exec sftp sh -c "chown -R admin:admin /home/admin; chmod 755 /home/admin; mkdir -p /home/admin/upload /home/admin/download; chown admin:admin /home/admin/upload /home/admin/download; chmod 777 /home/admin/upload; chmod 755 /home/admin/download;  ls -la /home/"
pause 

### vsftp

docker run -d -v D:\work\docker\vsftpd\upload:/home/vsftpd -p 20:20  -p 21:21 -p 21100-21110:21100-21110 -e FTP_USER=root -e FTP_PASS=root --name ftp fauria/vsftpd

### ELK
#### elasticsearch

docker network create elk-network

docker run -d --name elasticsearch --network elk-network -p 9200:9200 -p 9300:9300 -e "discovery.type=single-node" -e "xpack.security.enabled=false" -e "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms1g -Xmx1g" -v D:\work\docker\ELK\es:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.13.0


docker run -d --name elasticsearch --network elk-network -p 9200:9200 -p 9300:9300 -e "discovery.type=single-node" -e "xpack.security.enabled=false" -e "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms1g -Xmx1g" -v es-data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.13.0
支持jdbc的

docker volume create es-data

docker run -d --name elasticsearch --network elk-network -p 9200:9200 -p 9300:9300 -e "discovery.type=single-node" -e "xpack.security.enabled=false" -e "xpack.license.self_generated.type=trial" -e "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms1g -Xmx1g" -v es-data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.13.0



#### kibana
docker run -d --name kibana --network elk-network -p 5601:5601 -e "ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS=http://elasticsearch:9200" docker.elastic.co/kibana/kibana:8.13.0
